# Blue Blocks Montessori School & Micro Research Institute
> Last updated: 2026-09-29T12:50:24.376Z

> Blue Blocks is an AMI-certified Montessori school and micro-research institute in Hyderabad, India, offering a continuous developmental education from 15 months to 18 years (Ages 1-18), integrated with the Cambridge IGCSE curriculum. The school operates two campuses (Gachibowli and Tellapur) and houses innovation labs in space technology, drone engineering, and biomimicry. The Blue Blocks Micro Research Institute conducts a 17-year longitudinal observational study of child development across 1,047 children.

Canonical: https://blueblocks.in/
Primary email: info@blueblocks.in
Primary phone: +91 9000955050
WhatsApp: +91 9000955053
Founded: 2009

## Core pages

- [Home](https://blueblocks.in/): Overview of the AMI Montessori continuum, 0-18 developmental architecture, and research-led pedagogy.
- [About Us](https://blueblocks.in/about-us/): Founding story, founder bios (Pavan Goyal, Munira Hussain), 17-year longitudinal dataset, Times of India recognition, BBMRI mission.
- [Programs](https://blueblocks.in/programs/): Full program catalogue across the four planes of Montessori development.
- [Innovation](https://blueblocks.in/innovation/): Innovation Lab, Drone Lab, Space Lab, Biomimicry Hive, CubeSat Mission.
- [Admissions](https://blueblocks.in/admissions/): Admissions process, parent orientation, entry windows, Cambridge integration.
- [Campus](https://blueblocks.in/campus/): Octagonal classrooms, biophilic design, Innovation Infrastructure (CESDI), kinaesthetic landscape.
- [Careers](https://blueblocks.in/careers/): Open roles for AMI guides, educators, innovation lab leads, and operations staff.
- [Contact](https://blueblocks.in/contact-us/): Both campus addresses, phone, email, and enquiry form.
- [FAQ](https://blueblocks.in/faq/): Common questions about Montessori, admissions, and Cambridge IGCSE integration.
- [Blog](https://blueblocks.in/blog/): Articles on Montessori, parenting, innovation pedagogy.
- [Video Catalog](https://blueblocks.in/video-catalog/): Cinematic classroom, farm, drone lab, and community videos.

## Innovation Labs

- [Innovation Lab](https://blueblocks.in/innovation/innovation-lab/): Ethical making and design facility with 500 tools across all three Planes of Development.
- [Drone Lab](https://blueblocks.in/innovation/drone-lab/): Student drone research; 5 patent applications filed by elementary students aged 8-12.
- [Space Lab](https://blueblocks.in/innovation/space-lab/): Student-led aerospace research; CubeSat payload development.
- [Biomimicry Hive](https://blueblocks.in/innovation/biomimicry-hive/): Hexagonal research space designed by IIT Hyderabad for nature-inspired innovation.
- [CubeSat Mission](https://blueblocks.in/innovation/cubesat-mission/): IN-SPACe-authorised student CubeSat payload (Project SBB-1).

## Research and Publications

- [Research Institute](https://blueblocks.in/research-institute/): Blue Blocks Micro Research Institute mission, methodology, ethics, governance.
- [Papers](https://blueblocks.in/papers/): The four published developmental papers.
- [Publications](https://blueblocks.in/publications/): Authorisation dossiers, longitudinal studies, methodological contributions, patents.

## Foundational Papers

- [Neuropsychiatry of the Toddler Plane](https://blueblocks.in/neuropsychiatry-of-toddler-plane/): Developmental architecture for the toddler community, grounding movement, language, and early executive function.
- [The Conscious Construction of Intelligence](https://blueblocks.in/the-conscious-construction-of-intelligence/): Developmental architecture of the Children's House and the transition from unconscious to conscious absorption.
- [The Architecture of the Universe](https://blueblocks.in/the-architecture-of-the-universe/): Elementary developmental framework linking Cosmic Education, moral reasoning, and innovation readiness.
- [The Social Newborn](https://blueblocks.in/adolescent-social-newborn-paper/): Third-plane developmental foundations for the adolescent community and social valorization.

## Publications

- [IN-SPACe Authorization: Student CubeSat Mission](https://blueblocks.in/publications/inspace-authorization-cubesat-mission/): Formal authorization and mission-governance documentation for Blue Blocks student CubeSat participation.
- [A Longitudinal Study of Innovation Development (0–18)](https://blueblocks.in/publications/longitudinal-innovation-development-0-18/): A developmental continuum study tracking innovation capacities from birth through adolescence.
- [Research Briefs Series](https://blueblocks.in/publications/research-briefs-series/): Short publications addressing specific developmental and pedagogical research questions.
- [Methodological Contributions: Observation Protocols](https://blueblocks.in/publications/methodological-contributions-observation-protocols/): Observation coding systems, reliability protocol notes, and analytical framework documentation.
- [Drone Patent Series (Student Filings, 2019)](https://blueblocks.in/publications/drone-patent-series-2019/): Consolidated overview of student drone patent applications and design intent documentation.

## Credentials and recognition

- AMI (Association Montessori Internationale) certification across all four planes (0-3, 3-6, 6-12, 12-18).
- Cambridge International School (Cambridge Assessment International Education).
- Best Pre-School in Hyderabad - Times of India (3 consecutive years).
- ISRO IN-SPACe authorisation for student CubeSat mission (2025).
- Invited presentation - Nobel Peace Centre, Oslo (2024).
- Verified educational institution - U.S. Department of State.
- Affiliation - Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad (IIT-H).
